notes: Several key vocabulary items (girl, bear, porridge, chair, bed, bowl) already exist in activity_images and aac_extras (hot, cold, big, small) — these can be reused directly. 'house' replaces 'forest' and 'door/window' as a more functional single location word for this board's limited fringe slots. 'broken' is a high-value story word (broken chair) and should show a cracked or broken object. 'sleeping' captures a key story action (Goldilocks found sleeping in bed). 'small' from aac_extras was omitted from fringe since 'big' covers the size contrast and 'same/different' in core row 2 can scaffold size comparison; if a 12-slot expansion were available, 'small' would be the next addition. Consider pairing this board with a separate story sequencing strip (forest → house → porridge → chair → bed → bears return → run away) for comprehension activities.
